name: Turbopump assembly
description: Pumps fuel and oxidizer through staged impellers. Higher tiers stabilize powered cruise.

name: Injector and chamber
description: Metered injector plate and insulated combustion chamber. Required for sustained high thrust.

name: Regenerative cooling
description: Copper coolant channels, heat exchanger and thermal shielding around the chamber.

name: Expansion nozzle
description: Converging-diverging nozzle and reinforced bell. Converts chamber pressure into exhaust velocity.
